finish_config_template.prompt:
Create an additive four-second combined animation of the existing fur panda dancing while its actual small shoulder dragon takes off, flies beside it, and lands on the same shoulder. Do not substitute the standalone dragon or overwrite approved assets. Use the parent-approved separated source only after its path and SHA256 are bound. The separated hidden contact surfaces and their source-texture UV patches are authored repairs, not recovered original anatomy.
Derive all panda appearance, original16 bones, base weight layers and weight constraints from examples/meshy/muse-panda-dance-v4.json. This reverts the rejected v3 tighter foot-weight experiment, which increased ankle edge extension to about25mm. Preserve the6500-parent/30-child native groom, regional flow,2400 source-colored portable cards, rear-tail material correction, normal strength.15,1024px/48 samples and denoising false. No new provider generation, texture repainting, surface smoothing or fabricated wing area.
Keep the exact v4 panda keys: four alternating one-second root hops, up to .10m lateral travel and .065m rise, up to4degree lean and8degree yaw during each airborne beat; alternating toe kicks are limited to4degrees. The12degree kick and tightened foot weights are rejected trials, not retained improvements. No large arm, wrist or finger gestures. Foot/belly coupling remains a native-verification concern.
Remove the old color-selected rigid CompanionAnchor attachment. Add CompanionRoot parented to Root plus DragonWingRight/Left children at inspected source pivots. Apply part_rigs only to companion_surface and companion_cap, with CompanionRoot as the weighting-only base. Keep actual global parenting. Wing fields blend each wing with CompanionRoot under ORIGINAL full-mesh bounds, retaining measured asymmetric folded geometry.
Author21 explicit LINEAR keys from0 to4seconds. The companion anticipates while perched, moves negative world X before rising, follows a short outward arc .27-.30m above its original shoulder pivot, then descends outside the panda head and settles by3.8seconds. Full Root XYZ rotation, not only lean, is compensated: R=Rz*Ry*Rx; target=(1-w)*(P+T+R*(C-P))+w*C+offset; child_translation=transpose(R)*(target-P-T)-(C-P). For orientation use child_rotation=exp(-w*log(R))*Rx(flight_pitch), converted back to XYZ Euler; this cancels inherited lean/yaw while airborne and blends back to the moving perch. Exact values and derivation are preserved in choreography-design-v2.json.
Flap the real right wing with Y plus/minus14degrees and the folded left wing with X plus/minus12/Y minus/plus6degrees; taper into launch and landing. Keep camera_fit motion. First and final keys are the same neutral pose; do not claim a seamless loop without verification. The earlier source-derived wing screen omits final closure geometry; verify final weights, all-frame floor/framing/edge extension, wing articulation, exported skin motion and actual rendered semantics. This is authored toy choreography, not gravity, balance, collision or aerodynamic simulation, recovered movement or Muse-quality equivalence.

native_field_schema_check.method: finish_generated.validate on an in-memory copy using the existing base source strings only for schema type checks; this did not read, validate or bind a separated model.

coordinate_contract.part_weights: CompanionRoot plus descendants; base_bones=[CompanionRoot] in the weighting-only derived rig. Real CompanionRoot remains parented to Root. Original full-mesh bounds, never part-local bounds.
coordinate_contract.translation_equation: R=Rz(z)*Ry(y)*Rx(x) from the complete panda Root Euler. target=(1-w)*(P+T+R*(C-P))+w*C+offset; CompanionRoot translation=transpose(R)*(target-P-T)-(C-P).
coordinate_contract.wing_rotations: DragonWingRight global-rest Euler Y ±14 degrees; DragonWingLeft global-rest Euler X ±12/Y ∓6 degrees, scaled by flap_fraction. Different axes accommodate the actual asymmetrically folded wing patches.
coordinate_contract.orientation_equation: CompanionRoot Euler encodes exp(-w*log(R))*Rx(flight_pitch). Actual world orientation is exp((1-w)*log(R))*Rx(flight_pitch); inverse Euler angles cannot be obtained by simply negating XYZ values.
coordinate_contract.bounds_source: Retained full source-derived world bounds from design-v1; must match final source after calibration.
